Grace and peace will surely follow us
Through the years when Your children suffer
You desire that our joy be full
I remember all Your deeds of old
I gladly offer everything as a living sacrifice
Lord, light a warm and shining candle today
Shine into the darkness and come among us
If the Lord allows the saints to gather once again
The Lord’s true light will stay with us through the lonely night
Wonderfully sheltered by good powers
We confidently await whatever may come
God is with us in the evening and in the morning
And surely on every new day
The Father surrounds us, and rest comes upon this world
The unseen kingdom descends from heaven
The lovely song of saints and angels rises
In silence we listen to the sound of heaven
